issues.description: The problem statement requires the RGB color to be passed in register ECX and for set_pixel to write that color to the computed framebuffer address. The solution implementation of set_pixel instead uses EDX and performs 'mov [eax], edx', while EDX at that point holds the high part of a multiplication (not the color). This is an unintended mismatch: the conceptual parameter (RGB color) is referenced with different registers across artifacts and the solution therefore writes an incorrect value.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the set_pixel implementation use ECX as the color parameter (as stated in the problem). Preserve ECX across the multiplications (e.g. push ecx at the start and pop ecx before writing), compute the byte offset correctly, add display_start and then store the color with 'mov [address], ecx'. Ensure any registers other than EAX are saved/restored so the subroutine preserves all registers except EAX as required.
